digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and child process runtime environment isolation
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths use broad parent environments and implicit DIG fallbacks instead of scoped S2 runtimes, risking unintended scope writes and credential leakage to unrelated siblings
Jira Cloud scope contains four implicit DIG defaults: resolve_jira_settings, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default, none fail closed when scope is missing
Child processes inherit full parent environment and adapter secrets instead of receiving only their owning overlay while removing other adapters' declared secret names
Thread operation bindings, ReconcilerSettings, GitRuntime, and BridgeRuntime through apply, mutation, binding, Git, and delivery paths with removed fallbacks to establish scoped runtime usage
Eliminate every implicit DIG default so requests fail closed with typed error unless DIG is explicitly configured, preserving retry, rate-limit, TLS, idempotency, and delivery behavior
